instructions.description: Trigger an illegal-instruction exception using a canonical 32-bit all-zero encoding.
Trigger an illegal-instruction exception using the 16-bit compressed all-zero encoding.
Load the address of a general-dynamic thread-local storage (TLS) variable via a GOT TLS descriptor.
Load the tp-relative offset of an initial-exec thread-local storage (TLS) variable via the GOT.
Load the address of a TLSDESC descriptor for a dynamic thread-local storage variable.
Vector pseudo-instruction: set mask elements where signed vector elements are greater than or equal to scalar `rs1`.
Quiet single-precision floating-point greater-than-or-equal comparison (`rs >= rt`, alias for `fleq.s rd, rt, rs`).
Quiet double-precision floating-point greater-than-or-equal comparison (`rs >= rt`, alias for `fleq.d rd, rt, rs`).
Quiet half-precision floating-point greater-than-or-equal comparison (`rs >= rt`, alias for `fleq.h rd, rt, rs`).
Quiet single-precision floating-point greater-than comparison (`rs > rt`, alias for `fltq.s rd, rt, rs`).
Quiet double-precision floating-point greater-than comparison (`rs > rt`, alias for `fltq.d rd, rt, rs`).
Quiet half-precision floating-point greater-than comparison (`rs > rt`, alias for `fltq.h rd, rt, rs`).
Atomically swap a 32-bit shadow-stack word at `(rs1)` with `rs2` using acquire ordering (Zicfiss).
Atomically swap a 32-bit shadow-stack word at `(rs1)` with `rs2` using release ordering (Zicfiss).
Atomically swap a 32-bit shadow-stack word at `(rs1)` with `rs2` using acquire-release ordering (Zicfiss).
Atomically swap a 64-bit shadow-stack doubleword at `(rs1)` with `rs2` using acquire ordering (Zicfiss).
Atomically swap a 64-bit shadow-stack doubleword at `(rs1)` with `rs2` using release ordering (Zicfiss).
Atomically swap a 64-bit shadow-stack doubleword at `(rs1)` with `rs2` using acquire-release ordering (Zicfiss).
Compressed left-shift hint (`shamt == 0`) defined as a HINT in RV32C/RV64C.
Compressed logical right-shift hint (`shamt == 0`) defined as a HINT in RV32C/RV64C.
Compressed arithmetic right-shift hint (`shamt == 0`) defined as a HINT in RV32C/RV64C.
Read the floating-point control and status register (`fcsr`) into `rd`.
Write the floating-point control and status register (`fcsr`).
Load a vector mask register with unit-stride element byte accesses.
Store a vector mask register with unit-stride element byte accesses.
Count set mask bits in `vs2` under optional mask `vm`.
Bitwise vector mask `vs2 & ~vs1`.
Bitwise vector mask `vs2 | ~vs1`.
Unordered single-width floating-point sum reduction across active vector elements.
Widening unordered floating-point sum reduction across active vector elements.

directives.name: .align
directives.description: Align the location counter to a power-of-two boundary (2^n bytes on RISC-V). Prefer `.p2align` for portability across architectures.

directives.name: .asciz
directives.description: Emit a NUL-terminated ASCII string literal into the current section (alias for `.string`).

directives.name: .attribute
directives.description: Emit a RISC-V ELF object attribute tag and value (for example `arch` or `stack_align`).

directives.name: .balign
directives.description: Advance the location counter to the next multiple of `b` bytes, optionally padding with `pad_val`.

directives.name: .bss
directives.description: Switch to the `.bss` zero-initialized data section, creating it if it does not yet exist.

directives.name: .comm
directives.description: Allocate a common symbol of `size` bytes with optional alignment in the `.bss` section.

directives.name: .common
directives.description: Allocate a common symbol of `size` bytes with optional alignment in the `.bss` section (alias for `.comm`).

directives.name: .data
directives.description: Switch to the `.data` initialized writable data section, creating it if it does not yet exist.

directives.name: .double
directives.description: Emit one or more 64-bit IEEE 754 double-precision floating-point values.

directives.name: .endm
directives.description: End the current `.macro` definition block.

directives.name: .equ
directives.description: Define a symbol as an assembler constant expression.

directives.name: .file
directives.description: Emit an ELF `STT_FILE` local symbol naming the source file, or associate a DWARF file number and path.

directives.name: .float
directives.description: Emit one or more 32-bit IEEE 754 single-precision floating-point values.

directives.name: .globl
directives.description: Mark a symbol with global (`STB_GLOBAL`) ELF binding so the linker can resolve references from other object files.

directives.name: .ident
directives.description: Emit an identification string into the `.comment` ELF section.

directives.name: .2byte
directives.description: Emit one or more 16-bit integer values without automatic alignment.

directives.name: .4byte
directives.description: Emit one or more 32-bit integer values without automatic alignment.

directives.name: .8byte
directives.description: Emit one or more 64-bit integer values without automatic alignment.

directives.name: .byte
directives.description: Emit one or more 8-bit integer values into the current section.

directives.name: .dword
directives.description: Emit one or more 64-bit integer values into the current section.

directives.name: .half
directives.description: Emit one or more 16-bit integer values into the current section.

directives.name: .insn
directives.description: Assemble a custom instruction encoding directly from a format template, opcode, and operand fields.

directives.name: .long
directives.description: Emit one or more 32-bit integer values into the current section.

directives.name: .quad
directives.description: Emit one or more 64-bit integer values into the current section.

directives.name: .short
directives.description: Emit one or more 16-bit integer values into the current section.

directives.name: .word
directives.description: Emit one or more 32-bit integer values into the current section.

directives.name: .local
directives.description: Mark a symbol with local (`STB_LOCAL`) ELF binding, confining it to the current object file.

directives.name: .macro
directives.description: Begin a macro definition whose optional parameters are substituted as `\argname` in the body until `.endm`.

directives.name: .option
directives.description: Change RISC-V assembler options: `arch` (extensions), `push`/`pop` (save/restore), `rvc`/`norvc` (compressed), `relax`/`norelax` (linker relaxation), and `pic`/`nopic` (PIC).

directives.name: .p2align
directives.description: Advance the location counter to a `2^p2`-byte boundary, optionally specifying a fill byte and maximum padding bytes.

directives.name: .rodata
directives.description: Switch to the `.rodata` read-only data section, creating it if it does not yet exist.

directives.name: .section
directives.description: Switch to the named ELF section (default `.text`), creating it with the given flags and type if it does not yet exist.

directives.name: .size
directives.description: Set the ELF symbol table size (`st_size`) of a symbol, typically used for functions and data objects.

directives.name: .sleb128
directives.description: Emit a signed LEB128 variable-length integer (commonly used in DWARF debug and unwind tables).

directives.name: .string
directives.description: Emit one or more NUL-terminated string literals into the current section.

directives.name: .text
directives.description: Switch to the `.text` executable code section, creating it if it does not yet exist.

directives.name: .type
directives.description: Set the ELF symbol type (`st_info`, such as `@function` or `@object`) of a symbol.

directives.name: .uleb128
directives.description: Emit an unsigned LEB128 variable-length integer (commonly used in DWARF debug and unwind tables).

directives.name: .variant_cc
directives.description: Annotate a symbol with the `STO_RISCV_VARIANT_CC` ELF flag indicating a non-standard calling convention.

directives.name: .zero
directives.description: Emit the specified number of zero-initialized bytes.
